_README: Every {{PLACEHOLDER}} in paper.md is resolved from here at build time.
An unresolved placeholder FAILS the build (see build.py). Never type a
number into the prose. `python3 build.py --draft` renders the gaps in red
instead of failing, so the paper can still be read while data lands.
value from JSON : {"file": <path from repo root>, "path": <dotted or list>,
LaTeX fragment  : {"tex_file": <path from repo root>}  (inserted verbatim)
fixed string    : {"literal": <string or null>}  (null = author must fill in)
gloss modes: "x_in_n" turns a percentage into plain English ("about four in
every five"); "fraction_word" turns a 0-1 ratio into "about a quarter".
Convention (REVIEW_ROUND2 A2): every single-number share in the body uses the
TIE-AWARE statistic (a tie counts as half a win for each side), matching
Figure 1, the last column of Table A1, and Tables A3-A5. The plain (non-tie-aware)
`pct_male` fields still exist in the JSON and are used only inside the
three-way-split tables, never for a single prose number.
`needs` on every entry says what the producing script writes there.
